children.game_version: Follow-the-leader circle dance using the 'stroll' variation.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm punches and side-to-side swaying while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the arm punches and swaying without the running-man leg motion.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo to match reggae-style pacing.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Alternating bent-elbow fist-punches, left and right.
movement_profile.footwork: Running-man motion of the legs to the beat.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dancers often form a circle or a 'pit'.
movement_profile.partnering: Not a partner dance; performed individually within a group.

signature_moves.description: Dancers move in a circle, swaying side to side with bent arms and marching in sync.
signature_moves.name: Stroll

signature_moves.description: A punk-style variation featuring sharp striking arm movements.
signature_moves.name: Two-stepping

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Varies by genre; slower for reggae, fast and technical for drum and bass.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Actual striking or hurting other dancers; trampling those who fall.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Prominent backbeat on beats two and four.
music_profile.sound_description: The music is defined by a strong backbeat played by the electric guitar on the second and fourth beats of a 4/4 bar.

basic_steps: Running-man leg motion to the beat.
Alternating bent-elbow fist-punches, left and right.
teaching.formation: Usually performed in a 'pit' or a circle.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on the synchronization of the leg motion with the arm punches.
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 time with a prominent backbeat on beats two and four.
